task: RetryPolicy/Retrier: exponential backoff retry with injectable Sleeper and checked RetryExhaustedException
reasoning_summary: RetryPolicy is a validated record whose delayBefore grows iteratively and caps at maxDelay, catching ArithmeticException so huge attempts/multipliers cannot overflow. Retrier takes an injectable Sleeper so tests record delays instead of sleeping, and restores the interrupt flag when interrupted. Tests were written first and 19 passed on the first run.
